title: Personal Auto policy
fideon:note: Generated from the supplied personal_auto.schema.json v1.4.0 by scripts/build_canonical_policy_schemas.py. Do not hand-edit; edit the source and regenerate. Extended by scripts/canonical_schema_extensions.py with fields the supplied skeleton did not carry; re-run it after any regeneration.

fideon:source.gap_analysis_extensions: 2026-09-25: personal auto gap analysis of 26 PDFs from 8 carriers (AEIC, Hagerty, MAPFRE, Mercury, NYCM, Plymouth, Progressive, Travelers). 89 schema nodes added (declarations form number, NY DMV insurer code, original inception date, purchase date/time, product code, named/co-insured demographics, contact table, insurance score vendor, per-vehicle MVLE fee / optional coverages premium / discount total, supplemental spousal liability premium and rate, remittance and bill-plan options, UM and SUM per-person/per-accident limits, statutory UM and SUM out-of-state indicators, no-fault benefit periods, transportation and substitute transportation daily/maximum limits, roadside towing distance, rental vehicle coverage premium-charge election, coverage_packages[], vehicle/driver change status, accident prevention course date, class code components, residence type, id_cards[], printed name on declination forms); printed labels added as aliases on existing fields. Misplaced aliases moved: Inception Date (policy.effective_date -> policy.original_inception_date), Coverage Details and Coverage Summary (auto.liability_coverages -> auto.vehicles[].coverages[] / document.document_title_as_stated); ISSUE DATE on auto.drivers[].date_licensed replaced by LICENSE ISSUE DATE; Roadside Assistance now also names auto.physical_damage_coverages.roadside_assistance_limit. Merged duplicate fields: auto.physical_damage_coverages.other_than_collision_deductible -> comprehensive_deductible; auto.no_fault_benefits.basic_economic_loss_limit -> mandatory_pip_limit. Applied directly to this file. Gold review (same day, 23 generated samples checked against their scans): Name -> named_insured.primary_name (was taken by third_party_designee.name); Actual Cash Value off physical_damage_coverages.valuation_basis; Comprehensive / Other Than Collision / Collision moved to the premium fields (the amount printed after them is the premium) and Comprehensive deductible / Collision deductible added to the deductibles; bare Bodily Injury / Property Damage / EACH ACCIDENT removed (they matched discount lines); EFF DATE moved to document.transaction_effective_date; Pay in Full / Pay in Installments moved to the option totals; auto.vehicles[].unit_description and auto.vehicles[].total_loss_settlement_basis declared (the generator writes both). Bare 'Comprehensive' / 'Collision' removed from the premium fields: the amount printed after them is the premium on some forms (Hagerty) and the deductible on others (Plymouth). billing.remittance_payable_to renamed billing.payable_to, the name the generator writes.

date.note: US insurance documents print dates month/day/year, so every date's parsed value is MM/DD/YYYY: two-digit month and day, four-digit year, whatever the page prints (5/6/26, May 6, 2026 and 2026-05-06 are all parsed as 05/06/2026). raw stays exactly as printed. applies_to matches field names such as effective_date, date_of_birth and replaces_prior_declaration_dated. A form edition_date ("04/07") has no day and keeps its printed form. A value that is not a calendar date ("Full Prior Acts", "None") has parsed null. Compare dates as dates, not strings: as text, 12/31/2025 sorts after 01/01/2026 - this includes the date_ordering audit rules.
